extension.description: Open JSON, JSONL lines, selections, and escaped JSON strings as recursive tree views.
command.openDocument.title: Open Document as Tree
command.openCurrentLine.title: Open Current Line as Tree
command.openSelection.title: Open Selection as Tree
command.openClipboard.title: Open Clipboard as Tree
config.autoExpandMaxNodes: Automatically expand every object and array when the JSON contains at most this many value nodes. Set to `0` to disable automatic descendant expansion. Roots above the 10,000-node materialization limit remain collapsed.
config.maxValueNodes: Maximum number of JSON value nodes (objects, arrays, and primitives) parsed for one tree or document. Larger values use more Extension Host memory — roughly 250 MB per million nodes.
config.liveRefreshMaxCharacters: Trees opened from a document re-parse automatically after edits while the parsed text has at most this many characters; larger text shows a **Refresh** button instead. Set to `0` to always refresh manually.
